title: The Lord's Challenge to the Idols and the Ruler from the East
description: The Lord calls the nations to judgment and asks who has stirred up the conqueror from the east who subdues kings before him. He assures Israel, his servant and Jacob’s descendants, that they need not fear, for the Lord holds their right hand and is their Redeemer. He promises water in the wilderness and lush trees in the desert for the poor and needy. Finally, the Lord challenges the idols to predict the future to prove their divinity, but they are mere emptiness and wind, while he himself has raised up one from the north and from the rising sun, giving Zion and Jerusalem a messenger of joy.
